scope: Flat arithmetic dispatch, compiler dataflow optimization and direct conditional branches. All ESP32 VM comparisons use IRAM. No playback cache or runtime analysis added.

method.host: Criterion, logical CPU 2, 1s warmup, 3s measurement, 50 samples, slope estimate with 95% CI. Isolated target directories and verified embedded source path for each variant. No concurrent builds during timings.
method.device: ESP32 rev3.1, 240MHz, standalone profiling image, no Wi-Fi or GPIO. Both native VM functions in IRAM in every variant. 32 frames/case including first use; CRC outside timing. Interrupted PCs at 997/1999us bracketed by unsampled controls.
method.counts: Separate instrumented host executions; counts do not affect measured executables.
method.equivalence: Same definitions, parameter contracts and timestamps. Recompiled for each current bytecode format. All 608 host frame CRCs identical; all captured device frames verified against their host manifest.

caveats: Prepared evaluation and output-buffer encoding only; no network, storage, DMA or physical LEDs.

Self-symbol samples include inlined helpers and cannot isolate removable dispatch cost. Estimated hotspot microseconds multiply sample share by unsampled warm frame time, not direct per-function timing.
Only 32 individual frames per device case; not long-run latency statistics.
Real arithmetic permits rounding changes; matching these output CRCs is workload evidence, not a claim of bit-identical floating-point intermediates.

entry_placement_experiment.conclusion: Only the entry wrapper and its literals moved; both VMs were already in IRAM. Flat Shimmer warm mean falls 5408.0us to 3634.1us; final optimized warm mean is essentially unchanged at 3263.1us. The evidence establishes placement sensitivity, not a specific cache-miss mechanism. The product keeps the hot entry in IRAM at a 1956-byte native placement cost.

optimized_host_hotspots_status: Not collected: Windows did not grant administrator consent for the Samply ETW helper (exit status -1). Original laptop self-symbol profiles remain baseline-only; updated laptop timing and dynamic instruction counts were collected.

remaining_instruction_patterns.method: Executed within-invocation sequences, including taken branches and loop backedges. Counts overlap and are not proof of adjacent instructions, producer-consumer dependence, legal fusion or removable time.

validation.focused_tests: constant propagation, loop/copy state, boolean reuse, short-circuit sampling and errors
validation.criterion_compare: passed, including unchanged checksum and active-effect assertions

impact_burst_control.reason: Initial sequential suite showed a 4.6% laptop regression. Repeated interleaved executions did not reproduce it; optimized was about 9% faster in both controls. No source change between runs.

criterion_comparison.method: pnpm bench:effect-vm:save before changes; pnpm bench:effect-vm:compare after changes. 3s warmup, 5s measurement, 100 samples. Baseline overlapped some unrelated preparation/build work; use the isolated controlled laptop comparison above for primary claims.
